name: U18-1-in_process
steps: if(window.__sim.host.tasks.find(t=>t.title==='Summarize the project').attention_count!==0)throw Error('Helper still needs attention');[...document.querySelectorAll('p')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Summarize the README · Ended with the agent process'))?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});

name: U18-2-stop-receipt-order
steps: const r=document.querySelector('.screen');if(!r?.textContent.includes('Agent process ended on the computer'))throw Error('Missing process receipt');document.querySelector('.work-body .notice')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});const heading=[...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Stop receipt');heading?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});

const facts=[...document.querySelectorAll('.agent-stop-summary .agent-stop-fact')];const text=document.querySelector('.agent-stop-summary')?.textContent||'';if(text.indexOf('Next up paused')<text.indexOf('Agent process ended on the computer'))throw Error('Next up precedes process');

name: U18-3-tablet
steps: const box=document.querySelector('.terminal-output').getBoundingClientRect();const grid=document.querySelector('.xterm-screen').getBoundingClientRect();const cursor=document.querySelector('.xterm-cursor')?.getBoundingClientRect();const body=document.querySelector('.terminal-screen .screen__body').getBoundingClientRect();if(grid.bottom>box.bottom+0.5)throw Error('Terminal rows clipped: '+JSON.stringify({box:box.toJSON(),grid:grid.toJSON()}));if(!cursor)throw Error('Cursor missing');if(cursor.bottom>Math.min(box.bottom,body.bottom,innerHeight)+0.5||cursor.top<box.top-0.5)throw Error('Cursor row clipped: '+JSON.stringify({cursor:cursor.toJSON(),box:box.toJSON(),body:body.toJSON()}));
